caseStudies.title: ShortSport
caseStudies.overview: Founded and built ShortSport, a sports news app for busy sports fans using GatsbyJS, Contentful headless CMS and published in the Apple Appstore with over 1,000 users
caseStudies.tech: GatsbyJS, CSS, HTML, Contentful, Firebase, REST APIs, GraphQL
challenge: Build a fully functioning sports news app
Conduct performance marketing to gain users
actions: Designed and built sign in/sign up user flow
Included like and comment on posts
Integrated with headless CMS for content
caseStudies.takeaway: End to end project ownership covering the fundamentals of building an app, deploying to the AppStore and performance marketing
